# Authoritative C0 R2 API projection

This directory is the generated API-engine projection of the frozen,
independently accepted neutral C0 release:

- release: `c0-fixtures-r2` (`contractVersion` 2)
- release commit: `27c1807801397e2b1d05ab8b822a9f915fe03316`
- release digest:
  `0e64439c681a22fb4f02285c082ed8ffb7b465e732fde4e49757e9e3c9a5783e`
- authoritative domain: `contracts/c0/cases/problem.json`
- projected vector: `cases.envelopes.valid[0]`

`problem-envelope.json` is generated by `tool/gen_c0_projection.dart`. Its
`$generated` header binds the generator path, release ID, and release digest;
the remaining members are the authoritative problem envelope byte-for-byte in
pretty-canonical JSON form. `SHA256SUMS` authenticates the generated JSON.

Never edit either generated file by hand. Regenerate and verify them with:

```console
dart run tool/gen_c0_projection.dart
dart run tool/gen_c0_projection.dart --check
scripts/validate/c0-release.sh
```

The generator accepts projection data only from the authenticated
`contracts/c0/RELEASE.json`, `contracts/c0/SHA256SUMS`, and
`contracts/c0/cases/problem.json` inputs. The release validator additionally
checks every summed release byte, the four fail-closed domain schemas, the
formatter policy, exact R2 ancestry, the projected checksum, and regeneration
identity.

## Coverage boundary

`test/c0_conformance_test.dart` exercises every D-class API row in the frozen
R2 coverage map:

- build the type URI from `typeUri.valid[0].segments` through the owned
  `problemTypeUri` builder;
- round-trip the projected envelope through `Problem.fromJson` / `toJson`;
- consume the projected 404 body through `toResult`;
- prove the type gate discriminates a mutated URI; and
- assert authoritative data `{id: 42, resource: user}`.

This projection claims no Config, Identity, Result-wire, Auth, D-star, or
N-class coverage. Those obligations remain with their named owners and lanes.
